Initial release of yufluentcn-comp-track.

- Enables multi-dimensional competitor listing comparison based on pasted copy (title, bullets, description, keywords)
- Outputs actionable differentiation suggestions and opportunity points
- Runs securely in the Yufluent cloud via Harness; only TOKENAPI_KEY and requests required locally
- Supports Amazon, Shopify, and TikTok platforms, with multi-language capability (zh, en, es, de, fr, ja)
- Strict agent workflow and compliance guidelines included
- Easily integrates with other Yufluent ecommerce analysis skills
